query: Btwins Panaderia Nicaraguense, Little Havana, Miami, FL
name: Btwins Panadería Nicaraguense
address: 1550 SW 1st St #15, Miami, FL 33135, United States

reviewSamples.author: Diana E.
reviewSamples.text: The staff was friendly and many bread options. Smelled nice and fresh. I will be back to buy more.

reviewSamples.author: Jackie Rod
reviewSamples.text: I love this place,but my last visit I bought nacatamales and I was very disappointed,they were not good. In the other hand, the varieties of breads they have are amazing, every single one that I ordered was delicious! 5 to that.

reviewSamples.author: Dee Elle
reviewSamples.text: This little gem is on the cusp of little Havana. We were looking for something sweet & spotted this amazing little central American bakery. (truncated by Google, incomplete sentence)

reviewSamples.author: Jackie L
reviewSamples.text: I was ripped off I ordered a cake that supposed cost $165 at least that was the price I was told, but I was charged $212.12 when I questioned the charge, I was told is because they charge a fee when you pay with credit card what type of (truncated by Google, incomplete sentence)

language_notes: Letreros internos en espanol (Pan de Coco, aviso a clientes), base de clientes nicaraguense en Little Havana, resenas mencionan 'Nica Bread' y 'nacatamales'. Se construyo con es como idioma por defecto.
